description: Search Immovlan from the terminal with every site filter, keep a local history, and cross it with Immoweb: exclusives, re-listings, rented PEB F/G traps and division candidates.

novel_features.name: Cross-portal match
novel_features.description: Tell whether a stored Immovlan listing is also on Immoweb, at what price, or is Immovlan-only.

novel_features.name: PEB trap
novel_features.description: List PEB F or G properties that are currently rented: owners who can no longer re-let in Brussels since 2026.

novel_features.name: Bulk detail enrichment
novel_features.description: Fill missing detail fields (PEB letter, street, geo, rented, cadastral income, agency software) for many stored listings in one resumable pass.

novel_features.name: Division candidates
novel_features.description: Houses large enough to divide, ranked by €/m² within their postcode, with land, year, PEB and rented flags.

novel_features.name: Re-listing detector
novel_features.description: Listings that came back under a new reference, with their true first-seen date and price at each reference.

novel_features.name: Agency leaderboard
novel_features.description: Which agencies list in a zone, their PEB F/G share, private-seller share and the CRM software behind each feed.
